TemplateHome.Title: MAP module developer demo
TemplateHome.Description: Runnable, practical examples for building a MAP module.
TemplateHome.RuntimeDescription: Shows values MAP supplies to every module page. Use them when a page needs its current host context.
TemplateHome.NotificationsDescription: Shows success, warning, error, and confirmation messages. Use these helpers for clear feedback before or after user actions.
TemplateHome.FeaturesDescription: Open a lab, change a value, then copy the small example into your module.

Parameters.Title: Detail & parameters
Parameters.Description: Read optional or required values passed to a detail page.

Navigation.Title: Navigation
Navigation.Description: Open pages, pass parameters, manage Back history, and perform root navigation.

HeaderUi.Title: Header & UI
HeaderUi.Description: Change header content, Back button behavior, and menu or header visibility.

Localization.Title: Localization, context & menu
Localization.Description: Translate text, inspect host context, find menus, and load module components.

Database.Description: Call PostgreSQL and Oracle using BasePage helpers or low-level APIs.

Config.Description: Inspect host configuration and platform capabilities, then save only after confirmation.

Logging.Description: Work with sandbox logs and correlate a module error with a short ID.

TemplateDetail.Title: Parameter detail
TemplateDetail.Description: This page reads values supplied by OpenPageAsync.
TemplateDetail.GetParameterDescription: Reads an optional parameter. Returns the default value when missing or not convertible.
TemplateDetail.RequireParameterDescription: Reads a required parameter. Use it when the page cannot operate without that value.

TemplateNavigation.Title: Navigation lab
TemplateNavigation.Description: Use these helpers to move between pages without reimplementing navigation behavior.
TemplateNavigation.OpenPageDescription: Opens another page using the recommended helper. Navigation errors are handled and reported safely.
TemplateNavigation.ParametersDescription: Pass small values to the target page using a parameter object.
TemplateNavigation.HistoryDescription: Controls whether the current page is added to Back history. Back returns to the most recent page stored in that history.
TemplateNavigation.RootDescription: Opens a page as a new root and clears the previous Back history.
TemplateNavigation.SafeFailureDescription: Try an unknown page to see the standard navigation error notification.
TemplateNavigation.StepBDescription: Opens C with pushHistory set to false, so A remains the Back destination.
TemplateNavigation.StepCNote: C was opened without pushing B. Back returns directly to A.

TemplateHeaderUi.Title: Header and UI lab
TemplateHeaderUi.HeaderDescription: HeaderTitleKey sets the localized header title, HeaderContent displays custom header content, and ShowBack controls the Back button. Call RefreshHeader after changing any of these values.
TemplateHeaderUi.UiDescription: ToggleMenu and ToggleHeader switch the current visibility; SetMenu and SetHeader set an explicit state. Use them when a page needs more screen space, then restore the original values.
TemplateHeaderUi.NotificationsDescription: NotifySuccess, NotifyWarning, and NotifyError give standard feedback. Use ConfirmAsync before an action that needs the user's approval.

TemplateLocalization.Title: Localization, context and menu lab
TemplateLocalization.LocalizationDescription: Lang.T gets display text for the current language. Lang.SetLanguage changes the application's active language.
TemplateLocalization.ContextDescription: ClientContext provides current environment information such as ProgramId, user, IP address, and local path.
TemplateLocalization.MenuDescription: MenuService.FindById finds a menu or page by the ID declared in page.json. ModuleLoader.LoadComponentAsync loads its component from the menu assembly and component information.

TemplateDatabase.Title: Database lab
TemplateDatabase.OfflineNote: No database request runs during initialization. Offline endpoint errors are displayed safely.
TemplateDatabase.RecommendedDescription: QueryAsync<T> calls a PostgreSQL function and maps returned data to a DTO list; this is recommended for normal pages. ExecuteAsync calls a PostgreSQL procedure when no result data is required.
TemplateDatabase.LowLevelDescription: Allows an explicit DbName and lower-level JSON response handling. Use it when the BasePage helpers are not sufficient.
TemplateDatabase.OracleDescription: Sends a request directly to the Oracle DB API using a JSON payload.
TemplateDatabase.DbJsonDescription: Converts a .NET object to JsonElement using MAP JSON conventions.

TemplateConfig.Title: Configuration and platform lab
TemplateConfig.PlatformDescription: IAppConfigService reads the current host configuration, system information, and displays. IPlatformCapabilities indicates support for fullscreen, taskbar hiding, and display selection.
TemplateConfig.EditNote: The draft works even when no configuration exists. Save is manual and does not restart the application.
TemplateConfig.EditDescription: SaveAsync stores the current host configuration. Use it only after the user explicitly confirms the change.
TemplateConfig.RestartNote: Restart is separate from Save and always requires confirmation.
TemplateConfig.RestartDescription: RestartApp restarts the host after explicit confirmation. Use it only when a configuration change requires a new application session.

TemplateLogging.Title: Logging and error lab
TemplateLogging.LogStoreDescription: Writes, reads, and clears logs stored by the host. The demo only uses the 2099-12-31 sandbox day.
TemplateLogging.ErrorDescription: ModuleErrorId creates a short correlation ID so the user and logs can reference the same error. ErrorNotifier shows a module error notification with that ID.
TemplateLogging.FaultDescription: The nested example is opt-in and the error stays inside its boundary.

TemplateLifecycle.Title: Lifecycle lab
TemplateLifecycle.Description: PageCancellationToken is automatically cancelled when the page starts navigating away. Use it for loops, delays, HTTP calls, or other page-lifetime work.
TemplateLifecycle.CleanupDescription: DisposePageAsync is the page's single cleanup hook. Use it to dispose timers, unsubscribe events, and release resources.

TemplateUtilities.Title: Utilities lab
TemplateUtilities.Description: Small helpers that are useful when building a module.
TemplateUtilities.PageParamsDescription: Creates and reads a dynamic parameter set used for page navigation.
TemplateUtilities.DbJsonDescription: Converts a .NET object to JsonElement using MAP JSON conventions.
TemplateUtilities.MenuDescription: MenuTree finds menus or pages inside the menu tree. MenuTitle gets the menu title appropriate for the current language.
